name: Dust Bunny (Large)
descriptions: A surprisingly large clump of felted dust, hair, and small fibers.
Surprisingly solid to the touch.
The natural accumulation of forgotten corners.

name: Single Lost Sock
descriptions: A lone sock, slightly dusty and misshapen.
Its mate is nowhere to be found.
A common casualty of laundry and inertia.

name: Stray Coin (Low Denomination)
descriptions: A single, dusty coin.
Looks like it rolled and settled here long ago.
A minor piece of lost wealth.

name: Small Plastic Toy Animal
descriptions: A miniature plastic figure of an animal.
Scuffed and perhaps missing paint.
Escaped from a toy box or pocket.

name: Bent Paperclip
descriptions: A standard metal paperclip, twisted out of shape.
Seems to have served a purpose beyond holding paper.
A small, forgotten tool.

name: Empty Pen
descriptions: A plastic ballpoint pen.
Clicker still works, but the ink is long gone.
Reached the end of its useful life under here.

name: Crumpled Tissue
descriptions: A used paper tissue, dried and dusty.
Indicates a moment of sniffles or spills.
An ephemeral artifact.

name: Hair Tie (Stretched)
descriptions: A fabric hair tie, pulled out of shape.
No longer has much elasticity.
Slipped off a wrist or out of hair.

name: Bobby Pin
descriptions: A simple metal bobby pin.
Small and easily lost.
Fell during dressing or undressing.

name: Small Button (Plastic)
descriptions: A loose plastic button.
Probably fell off clothing worn in bed.
A tiny part detached from a whole.

name: Bottle Cap (Plastic)
descriptions: A plastic cap from a drink bottle.
Surprisingly clean despite its location.
Rolled away after a late-night drink.

name: Faded Remote Control
descriptions: A small remote control, dusty and worn.
Buttons might be sticky or unresponsive.
Lost utility under the bed.

name: Piece of Lego/Building Block
descriptions: A single plastic building block.
Sharp edges, vibrant color.
Escaped from a child's construction project.

name: Cracked Phone Screen Protector
descriptions: A sheet of plastic or glass with a prominent crack.
Saved a phone screen, but was discarded here.
Evidence of a close call.

name: Dried Up Eraser
descriptions: A small rubber eraser.
Hardened and no longer effective.
Rolled off a desk or nightstand.

name: Small Battery (AA/AAA)
descriptions: A single cylindrical battery.
Likely depleted.
Fell out of a remote or toy.

name: Tiny Screw or Nail
descriptions: A very small piece of metal hardware.
Seems out of place.
Dropped during a repair or assembly.

name: Used Cotton Swab
descriptions: A cotton swab.
Slightly discolored or bent.
Carelessly discarded and rolled away.

name: Empty Candy Wrapper
descriptions: A crinkled wrapper from candy or snack.
Suggests clandestine late-night eating.
Left behind as evidence.

name: Broken Crayon Stub
descriptions: A short piece of a colored crayon.
Might have snapped or been worn down.
Fell from a creative session.

name: Shopping List Fragment
descriptions: A torn piece of paper with a few words written on it.
Hard to discern the full message.
A discarded reminder.

name: Plastic Bread Tag
descriptions: The small plastic clip from a bread bag.
Simple and often overlooked.
A mundane tagalong.

name: Small Key (Unidentified)
descriptions: A single, small metal key.
Doesn't seem to belong to anything obvious nearby.
Unlocks a forgotten box or drawer?

name: Lost Earring Back
descriptions: A tiny metal or plastic backing for an earring.
Essential for securing jewelry.
Separated from its purpose.

name: Chapstick Cap
descriptions: The plastic cap from a tube of lip balm.
Often comes loose in pockets or bags.
Lost protection for dry lips.
